data.text: Checked 2026-10-31 against HEAD (git archive into a scratch folder, nothing in the repo touched): the prime line-budget test takes ~2.1 s on both HEAD and the working tree (3 alternating runs each), so the Scrum/timeline work did not slow it. HEAD's own full suite also failed on this machine: the same two perf tests (cold start without compaction 693 ms > 600, cold loadState ratio). The full suite is unstable here independent of these changes; it took 90.8 s at HEAD and 95.8 s now (+~100 tests). Another session's dev server was running in this folder at the time.
